paper.target: Paper-derived conditional transfer of a leading connectivity axis and a separate DMN-versus-two-sensory-means configuration statistic

data.holdout_scope: Procedure-level locked split only; source data and old task outputs were previously inspected.
data.template_limit: Atlas FSLMNI152/MNI152NLin6Asym and BOLD MNI152NLin2009cAsym are not shown to be nonlinearly registered. Retaining identity-world extraction is an explicit operational approximation.

split.rule: Within child/adult stratum sort by age then literal participant_id; adjacent pairs; hash salt|stratum|id1|id2; parity of first SHA256 byte selects discovery member.

preprocessing.support: Intersection of geometry-valid and residual-active parcels across discovery people only; frozen before held-out evaluation.
preprocessing.coverage: All seven networks must remain represented. Report parcel and network coverage without pretending a mathematical nonempty-network rule is scientific coverage validation.
preprocessing.heldout_inactive: Invalidate only that person's score on the frozen support; retain their identity, exact reason and all cohort denominators. Never shrink support or replace them.
preprocessing.independent_unit: participant, conditional on this fixed shared movie and convenience cohort

operator.group_FC: Equal-person mean of all discovery FCs on discovery-only support
operator.sparsity: ceil(0.1*P) largest signed entries per row, diagonal eligible, exact ties smaller source ID
operator.kernel: normalized angle, not the original paper's cosine recipe
operator.selection: Largest algebraic nontrivial eigenvector; no network-label-based component search
operator.tolerance_scope: Inherited numerical resolution only; not a biological stability or success threshold
operator.discovery_stability: All ten leave-one-discovery-participant fits on the same frozen support, report squared principal-axis overlap and gaps; do not select among them

primary.name: frozen_axis_heldout_Rayleigh_fraction
primary.per_person: Project unit discovery eigenvector away from held-out stationary mode; normalize; R=v^T S v; T=R/lambda1.
primary.flat_spectrum_diagnostic: The nontrivial spectral mean is (trace(K)-1)/(P-1). Report R minus this mean as descriptive excess only, not a null-test statistic. A flat spectrum gives T=1 for arbitrary axes and is not selective gradient transfer.
primary.summary: Defined-person mean/min/max and leave-one-defined-person mean range with expected/defined counts
primary.inference: Descriptive conditional transfer; no positive threshold, p-value, population confidence interval or random-parcel null

secondary.name: DMN_versus_two_sensory_means_configuration
secondary.sign_scope: positive: DMN mean lies in same direction from both sensory means; negative: between them; not global apex or significance
secondary.degeneracy: Exact min/max over centered diffusion-coordinate span of complete numerically unresolved leading eigenspace; basis-invariant generalized quadratic-form range
secondary.range_numerics: Column-max normalization before centering, exact-constant column removal, centered-column equilibration, SVD rank counts singular values >1e-10*largest. Invariance applies to numerically resolved certified spans, not transforms that lose information. Final source-backed acceptance envelopes remain a release gate.
forbidden: choosing favorable axis within degenerate block

must_finish_before_active_task: re-authenticate source bytes and metadata-derived split
measure train-only coverage and held-out eligibility without gradient endpoint tuning
independent source reconstruction and endpoint implementation
final public minimal output schema and justified numeric acceptance envelopes
fresh blinded Sol calibration on locked task version
qualification.hardness_status: unknown; source-free tests and an oracle pass cannot demonstrate difficulty
qualification.no_blanket_null: Every null reason must be independently established from authenticated source and public numerical rules

proposed_next_resource_contract.operation: Read-only structural and support pilot on existing pinned 20-person image, no model API
proposed_next_resource_contract.stop: Stop on source hash mismatch, ambiguous metadata, empty network support, spatial-contract contradiction or memory/time limit; do not substitute data/settings.

expanded_cohort_fallback.available_manifest_only: Adjacent SOCIALBRAIN-001/DEVCONN-001 manifests cover 155 released people (122 child,33 adult)
expanded_cohort_fallback.condition: Only propose expansion after the fixed20 structural pilot establishes a scientific limitation; lock a new cohort/split/resource contract before use.
